page.layout: One column of dictionary entries on one printed page, with Hebrew, Chaldaic, Syriac and Latin type. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. The catchword יבם sits alone at the lower right below the last line. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: יאש Pahel Ch. Spe destituere, Desperare facere, Ecclef.2.20. Ithpahel אתיאש Diffidit,dubitavit, Futur. ויתיאש בלביה Et dubitet in corde suo, Deut.29. 18.Jonath.
יבב Ch. Clamare, Vociferari, Clangere, Jubilare. Itpah. אתיבב Idem, Psal.65. v.ult. & 108.10.
יבבתא, יבבנא Chald. Vociferatio, Jubilatio, Clamor, Clangor. Vide praeterea in ינב.

יבל Aphel היבל & אויביל Ch. [illegible, ~4 letters] Syr. Attulit,apportavit,duxit,adduxit, deduxit, abduxit, deportavit,detulit. Ithpeh. אתובל Transferri, transportari, deportari. Syre [illegible, ~4 letters] Et deportatum est, Act. 7.45.
יבלין Ch.Rivi, Thren.3.48. Cōst. ליבלי אַא. Heb. לבול עץ Proventui arboris, Jesa.44.19.
[illegible, ~4 letters] Syr. [illegible, ~6 letters] Series genealogiarum nostrarum, Reg. Proventus vel decursus generationum nostrarum, Tremel. Jac.3.6.
יובלא, יובלא Ch. Jubilæus annus, sic dictus, quòd cornu arietino solenniter promulgari juberet. Nam יובל Hebræis Arietem & cornu arietis significat.
[illegible, ~4 letters] Syr. Onus, Sarcina. Plural. [illegible, ~4 letters]

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldaic and Syriac type is only partly legible at this scan resolution. Words marked illegible were not read letter by letter. The Hebrew headwords were copied as far as they could be made out, and their vowel points may be incomplete. The Syriac entries in lines 6, 8 and 12 are the least certain. The catchword is the Hebrew יבם at the lower right.
